description: A board of columns with cards people move between them: an order pipeline, support tickets, tasks. Each card is your own markup. Cards move by a Move menu on each card, by picking one up and placing it with the arrow keys or a tap, or by dragging with a mouse, a pen or a finger held on the card; every move is read out to screen readers and can be undone. A move fires kanban:move, and with move-url is sent to your app, which keeps it or sends it back with a reason. Readonly boards and columns, locked cards, and a button per column when they don't fit side by side, as on a phone. Works inside Livewire components, with wire:kanban-move.
